items.title: Official: Nashville Airport Authority Majority Votes In Favor Of Renaming After Dolly Parton
items.summary: Nashville International Airport (BNA) has taken its first formal step toward being renamed in honor of Dolly Parton. On September 11th, the Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority (MNAA) Board voted unanimously, 6-0, to begin the process of modifying the airport’s name to recognize the Tennessee-born country music legend, who died on August 25 at the age of 80.
